#| label: setup
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(".").resolve()
INFORME = HERE.parent / "informe"
sys.path.insert(0, str(INFORME))
import facts
from facts import n, i, pct, signed_pct, ic, md_table
from IPython.display import Markdown

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

matplotlib.rcParams.update(
    {
        "font.family": "sans-serif",
        "font.sans-serif": ["Arial", "DejaVu Sans"],
        "font.size": 9,
        "axes.spines.top": False,
        "axes.spines.right": False,
        "axes.grid": True,
        "grid.alpha": 0.25,
        "axes.titlesize": 10,
        "figure.constrained_layout.use": True,
    }
)
F = facts.build()
import shutil

Path("figuras").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(facts.REPORTS / "patterns" / "series", Path("figuras") / "series", dirs_exist_ok=True)
from PIL import Image

with Image.open(F["diario"]["backtest_figure"]) as image:
    panels = 4
    image.crop((0, 0, image.width, int(image.height * panels / 8))).save(Path("figuras") / "diario_backtest.png")
DATOS, CLAS, SEM = F["datos"], F["clasificadores"], F["semantico"]
# Patrón de la ráfaga de enero de 2025: el que tiene alerta de M11 esa semana y más reclamos en ajuste.
_rafaga = [p for p in F["catalogo"] if "2025-01-13" in (p.get("alert_weeks") or {}).get("validation", [])]
PATRON_RAFAGA = max(_rafaga or F["catalogo"], key=lambda p: p["fit_rows"])
shutil.copy(Path("figuras") / PATRON_RAFAGA["image"], Path("figuras") / "patron_rafaga.png")
SEMANAL, COMP, ALERTAS, DIARIO = F["semanal"], F["composicion"], F["alertas"], F["diario"]
CATALOGO, TABLA, CIERRE = F["catalogo"], F["tabla"], F["cierre"]
T1, T2, T3, T4 = (CLAS["tasks"][t] for t in ("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"))
TABPFN = CLAS["tabpfn"]
AZUL, GRIS, NARANJA, VERDE = "#2F5D8A", "#9AA5B1", "#D9822B", "#3C8D5A"

def git(*args):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=HERE, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        return "—"
GIT_SHA = git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD")
GIT_DATE = git("log", "-1", "--format=%cd", "--date=short")

# Índices de tablas y figuras: se leen de las secciones en el orden en que se incluyen.
ORDER = [
    "10_cap1_vision.qmd", "20_cap2_analisis.qmd", "30_cap3_propuesta.qmd", "40_cap4_metodologia.qmd",
    "45_construccion.qmd", "50_cap5_validacion.qmd", "53_resultados.qmd", "54_traccion.qmd", "55_discusion.qmd",
    "60_cap6_implementacion.qmd", "70_conclusiones.qmd",
]
def captions(kind):
    """Captions of labelled tables or figures, in document order."""
    found = []
    chunk = re.compile(r"^#\| " + kind + r"-cap: \"(.*)\"$", flags=re.M)
    image = re.compile(r"^!\[(.*?)\]\(.*?\)\{#fig-", flags=re.M)
    for name in ORDER:
        text = (HERE / "secciones" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        hits = [(m.start(), m.group(1)) for m in chunk.finditer(text)]
        if kind == "fig":
            hits += [(m.start(), m.group(1)) for m in image.finditer(text)]
        found.extend(caption for _, caption in sorted(hits))
    return found
